# Blue Gold
[![Download on Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Modrinth-1bd96a?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/blue-gold)
## Overview
This datapack adds a new custom crafting recipe that allows players to create **a diamond** using **one light blue dye** and **one gold ingot**. By combining these two items in a crafting table, players can obtain a diamond in an **alternative way**, adding a **unique progression twist** to the game.
